Why this outfit works: A floor-length silk dress in a deep jade green meets the formal level for a close family member at a sister's wedding, and it keeps the only bare zone to the arms, which suits the warm August afternoon. Jade picks up the grey-green of her eyes, flatters her warm skin and golden hair, and stays well away from white and ivory, which belong to the bride. Block heels stay steady on grass during the outdoor ceremony, and the satin and gold details carry the look into the restaurant evening without any change.
